title: Band battles: Lionel Hampton, Chick Webb, Goodman, Lunceford
summary: He recalls Basie's victories over Hampton's band, Chick Webb with Ella, and Goodman at Madison Square Garden.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well some of the most important things that I think that I enjoyed mostly was our battle at the Savoy Ballroom. We had quite a few of them up there with all the bands. With Erskine Hawkins, Benny Goodman. But the most things that I
enjoyed was our battle with Lionel Hampton.

Yes, you see, they had a a very good band and they had Dexter Gordon, Illinois Jacquet, Marshal Royal, Ernie Royal, the whole band was a good band. One of Lionel's best bands. And they had gotten a little cocky. We knew they had a good band but they were going to do so much to us. We always got the message that Lionel is supposed to do this and do that.
But we had the battle and there wasn't any doubt about who won it and nobody, they would always say Lionel had a very good band, but we won the battle.
Another one was with, a close one was with Chick Webb when he had Ella Fitzgerald when she had just made "A Tiskit a Taskit".
But you were supposed to have won that.
Because you know, my wife was doing publicity for Chick Webb at that time and she really engineered that.
Yes, because she wanted to prove to Chick you know, that the music could make it at that time. Whereas Chick felt that you'd got Ella and it's best to turn in a more commercial ......

Yes, well we, as I say, we didn't kill ourselves. We actually knew that we won that one and we also won the one against Benny Goodman in Madison Square Garden. And even Benny admitted it. And that's when Benny had a very good band.
What about Lunceford, did you ever come up against that?

We played against Lunceford but it wasn't too much of a battle for some reason. It was way up in Connecticut somewhere and although we played, I don't know, we just figured, to us it was more like just two bands playing.
Well the styles were too different I guess?
